component.name: DockerBento
component.summary: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes and networks

description.p: DockerBento is a desktop Linux application for managing Docker resources locally. It communicates directly with the Docker daemon via Unix socket and provides a dark-themed UI for managing containers, images, volumes, and networks.

ul.li: List, start, stop, restart, pause, and remove containers
View container logs in real-time with streaming support
Run new containers from images with full configuration
Manage images, volumes, and networks with prune support
Auto-refresh with smart diff updates to avoid screen flicker
Configurable Docker connection (Unix socket or TCP)
